''See also: [[Emperor’s Intent Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Emperor's [[Intent]] is a potent and pervasive force associated with the ruler of [[The Empire|the Empire]]. It manifests as an invisible, magnetic power that can compel others to follow his will and makes his speech impossible to ignore. This force is so overwhelming that it can erase the lesser wills of ordinary people and has been used to imbue objects, such as a bed or armor, with enough durability to survive extreme attacks. The [[Intent]] can be channeled through items like a crown or stored within devices to create an echo of the Emperor's personality, serving as a way to bolster his will or preserve a version of himself even after death. While it can be used as a weapon to explode outward in fury or to warp materials, it is also something that can be channeled by others, though doing so carries the risk of being submerged in his persona. Specialized rooms have even been engineered to disperse this energy using rotating [[stone]] arms and flowing [[water]].}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor’s [[Intent]] is an [[Authority|authority]] that can be channeled through a crown and utilized by the Emperor himself. While it has been used to stop blows from [[Urg’naut|Urg'naut]], this power can also reinforce armor for centuries, as seen when the [[Intent]] glued armor to [[Calder]]. Although it may be resisted through habit, attempting to [[Read]] an [[Imperial relics|Imperial relic]] can overwhelm any Reader, making the act of reading the [[Intent]] a perceived exercise in folly. Consequently, [[Calder]] views this [[Authority|authority]] as something he wishes to avoid wrestling with.}}
